name: 오우거 대장
creator: colorsocks
design: a squat broad gray-green ogre chieftain BOSS facing RIGHT. Compact two-head-tall body, thick short limbs, very wide shoulders and belly. Two hero-scale identity features: a broad grey helmet with TWO ivory horns, and ONE large broad grey cleaver with brown handle held firmly in the FAR/LEFT hand at the RIGHT side of the body pointing diagonally up-right, tip below helmet top. One simple tan fur shoulder mantle, brown belt and loincloth, short brown boots, two small lower ivory tusks. The other RIGHT empty hand is near the back hip. Arms connected clearly with one elbow each, upperarm+forearm less than half head height. Larger silhouette and slightly more distinct costume parts than ordinary goblins, but no texture, studs, scratches or tiny details. Seven flat colors only.
